caseName: Volkswagen of America, Inc. v. Trull
caseNameFull: Volkswagen of America, Inc., Et Al. v. Trull Et Al.

opinions.text:
C. A. 1st Cir. Motion of Product Liability Advisory Council, Inc., for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari denied.

Justice Souter took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and this petition.
